"""Receive one frozen owner input archive after separate operational approval."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import signal
import sys


PATH = "/var/lib/crewshal-phase2d-owner-inputs-v16.tar"
BYTES = 26583040
SHA256 = "b0ce8539cda286915524f589f8591cf5237aa4b2db47aafd4af0e1ac57dfaad0"


def upload() -> None:
    # CPython can add this locale after an empty-environment exec.
    if os.environ:
        if (
            sys.platform != "linux"
            or not sys.flags.isolated
            or not sys.flags.no_site
            or not sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode
            or dict(os.environ) != {"LC_CTYPE": "C.UTF-8"}
        ):
            raise ValueError("The isolated entry inherited an environment.")
        with open("/proc/self/environ", "rb") as inherited:
            if inherited.read(1):
                raise ValueError("The isolated entry inherited an environment.")
        del os.environ["LC_CTYPE"]
    if sys.platform != "linux" or (os.getuid(), os.getgid()) != (0, 0) or os.environ:
        raise ValueError("The isolated Linux root owner entry is required.")
    os.umask(0o077)
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (33554432, 33554432))
    signal.alarm(30)
    fd = os.open(PATH, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o400)
    sha, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    try:
        while data := sys.stdin.buffer.read(65536):
            count += len(data)
            if count > BYTES:
                raise ValueError("The original owner input archive exceeds its exact bound.")
            sha.update(data)
            view = memoryview(data)
            while view:
                written = os.write(fd, view)
                if written <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("The original owner input write is incomplete.")
                view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        if count != BYTES or sha.hexdigest() != SHA256:
            raise ValueError("The original owner input archive bytes differ.")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    signal.alarm(0)
    print(json.dumps({"owner_input_bytes": count, "sha256": sha.hexdigest()}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    upload()

def exact_file(path: Path, expected: str) -> None:
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        if (
            not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode)
            or (before.st_uid, before.st_gid) != (0, 0)
            or before.st_nlink != 1
            or before.st_mode & 0o022

            raise ValueError("Owner input file has no exclusive protected identity.")
        sha = hashlib.sha256()

        after = os.fstat(fd)
        fields = ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns")
        if sha.hexdigest() != expected or any(
            getattr(before, field) != getattr(after, field) for field in fields

            raise ValueError("Owner input file bytes or identity changed.")
    finally:

                + name
                + "\n"
                for name in NATIVE_FILES
            )
        if unit.endswith(".service"):
            text += (
                "BindReadOnlyPaths=" + str(NATIVE / "codex-resources/bwrap") + ":/usr/bin/bwrap\n"
            )
        if unit.endswith(".service"):
            text += (
                "BindReadOnlyPaths=" + str(exclusive_env) + ":/usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/env\n"
            )
        path = Path("/etc/systemd/system") / unit
        with path.open("x") as stream:
            stream.write(text)
        path.chmod(0o644)
    subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/systemctl", "daemon-reload"], check=True, env={})
    subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/systemctl", "start", UNITS[0]], check=True, env={})
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "/usr/bin/systemctl",
            "set-property",
            "--runtime",
            "crewshal-2d.slice",
            "MemoryMax=805306368",
            "MemorySwapMax=0",
            "TasksMax=128",
            "CPUQuota=100%",
            "CPUQuotaPeriodSec=100ms",
        ],
        check=True,
        env={},
    )
    common = Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/crewshal.slice/crewshal-2d.slice")
    for key, value in {
        "memory.max": "805306368",
        "memory.swap.max": "0",
        "pids.max": "128",
        "cpu.max": "100000 100000",
    }.items():
        if (common / key).read_text().strip() != value:
            raise ValueError("The common original kernel ceiling differs.")

    group = Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/crewshal.slice/crewshal-2d.slice") / UNITS[0]
    for key, expected in {
        "memory.max": "805306368",
        "memory.swap.max": "0",
        "pids.max": "128",
        "cpu.max": "100000 100000",
    }.items():
        if (group / key).read_text().strip() != expected:
            raise ValueError("The original owner aggregate control differs.")
    (group / "cgroup.subtree_control").write_text("+memory +pids +cpu")
    parent = group.parent
    if not {"memory", "pids", "cpu"} <= set(
        (parent / "cgroup.subtree_control").read_text().split()
    ):
        raise ValueError("The original owner parent controllers are not enabled.")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {"owner_inputs_prepared": True, "observer_started": False, "compiler_started": False}
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    prepare()

scripts/phase_2d_owner_input_upload_copy.source:
"""Receive one frozen owner input archive after separate operational approval."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import signal
import sys


PATH = "/var/lib/crewshal-phase2d-owner-inputs-v16.tar"
BYTES = 26583040
SHA256 = "b0ce8539cda286915524f589f8591cf5237aa4b2db47aafd4af0e1ac57dfaad0"


def upload() -> None:
    # CPython can add this locale after an empty-environment exec.
    if os.environ:
        if (
            sys.platform != "linux"
            or not sys.flags.isolated
            or not sys.flags.no_site
            or not sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode
            or dict(os.environ) != {"LC_CTYPE": "C.UTF-8"}
        ):
            raise ValueError("The isolated entry inherited an environment.")
        with open("/proc/self/environ", "rb") as inherited:
            if inherited.read(1):
                raise ValueError("The isolated entry inherited an environment.")
        del os.environ["LC_CTYPE"]
    if sys.platform != "linux" or (os.getuid(), os.getgid()) != (0, 0) or os.environ:
        raise ValueError("The isolated Linux root owner entry is required.")
    os.umask(0o077)
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (33554432, 33554432))
    signal.alarm(30)
    fd = os.open(PATH, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o400)
    sha, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    try:
        while data := sys.stdin.buffer.read(65536):
            count += len(data)
            if count > BYTES:
                raise ValueError("The original owner input archive exceeds its exact bound.")
            sha.update(data)
            view = memoryview(data)
            while view:
                written = os.write(fd, view)
                if written <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("The original owner input write is incomplete.")
                view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(fd)
        if count != BYTES or sha.hexdigest() != SHA256:
            raise ValueError("The original owner input archive bytes differ.")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    signal.alarm(0)
    print(json.dumps({"owner_input_bytes": count, "sha256": sha.hexdigest()}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    upload()
